_comment: Never one colour for long (notes/strange-words-plan.md 4). `shifting sky` wanders slowly from colour to
colour, keeping its own brightness so the night stays dark: between the colours written for it --
`red and blue shifting sky` -- or, where none were, through a few no sky should be, drawn for this Age.
The sky-drift step, written on purpose. `slow` and `swift` set how fast it goes.
